Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Our mission is to help people integrate technology into everyday life and to enable innovation through technology.
 We offer software development and infrastructure solutions, with advanced competences in Blockchain, Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning. All our offices (in Western Europe or nearshore, in CEE) are located within the boundaries of the European Union.
 We believe working in close cooperation with our clients and employees is the key to success; this means we offer people the best working environment in order to achieve the best results. We love entrepreneurial spirits and encourage people around us to be proactive and make the best decisions not only for business, but for their own personal development.
 Our nearshore Romanian offices are in Bucharest (Victoriei Square) and Iasi (Palace) and, with over 9000 team members at group level, we make sure we are always close to our customers.
 About the role: 
 As a Data Warehouse Developer, you will join our Business Intelligence team and contribute to the development of the company's enterprise analytics platform. You'll help transform data from multiple operational systems into reliable, high-quality information that supports reporting, business analytics and future AI initiatives across the organization.
 Working closely with Business Intelligence specialists and business stakeholders, you'll design, develop and optimize ETL processes, Data Warehouse components and SQL solutions, ensuring data is accurate, scalable and ready to support business decision-making.
 Previous experience with Vertica and Talaxie is a strong advantage, as these are the core technologies behind our analytics platform. However, if you have a solid background in SQL, ETL and Data Warehouse development,but not on Vertica or Talaxie we provide structured onboarding, training and mentoring to help you become productive quickly.
 What you will be working on: 
Designing, developing and maintaining the company's enterprise Data Warehouse platform.
Building and optimizing ETL pipelines that integrate data from multiple operational systems.
Developing scalable data models that support reporting, analytics and AI initiatives.
Working with large-scale datasets in a modern Business Intelligence environment.
Collaborating with BI specialists and business stakeholders to deliver reliable, high-quality data solutions.
 What you will do: 
Design, develop and maintain ETL/ELT processes for integrating data from multiple sources.
Develop and optimize SQL objects, including stored procedures, views and database functions.
Build and maintain Data Warehouse structures, including facts, dimensions and data marts.
Analyze and optimize SQL performance to ensure efficient data processing.
Investigate and enhance existing data models and business logic.
Contribute to the integration of new business domains into the enterprise Data Warehouse.
Ensure data quality, consistency and reliability across the platform.
Collaborate with Business Intelligence teams to define business rules and analytical models.
Document technical solutions and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives.
 Requirements: 
Minimum 3 years of hands-on SQL development experience (SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL or similar).
Minimum 2 years of experience with a graphical ETL tool (SSIS, Talend, Pentaho, Informatica or similar).
Strong experience developing and maintaining stored procedures, views and complex SQL logic.
Good understanding of Data Warehouse concepts, dimensional modelling, facts and dimensions.
Experience designing and maintaining ETL/ELT processes.
Experience working with relational databases.
Strong SQL query optimization and troubleshooting skills.
Experience with Vertica or other columnar databases (Snowflake, Redshift, ClickHouse, etc.).
Experience with Talaxie or other ETL platforms.
Basic Java knowledge.
Ability to understand complex business processes and translate them into scalable data solutions.
 Nice to Have: 
Experience with Enterprise BI tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Qlik or Looker.
Python scripting.
Experience working with large-scale enterprise Data Warehouse environments.
Experience in Retail, Distribution, Healthcare or Pharma industries.
 Once on board we offer various programs and benefits 
22 working days as Annual Vacation plus 3 additional days off.
Floating days
Medical Insurance at Signal Iduna.
Benefit Online platform access, with a 690 RON monthly allowance from which you can choose to invest in different wellbeing, financial or retail packages.
Company performance-based annual bonus prorated according to the number of worked months in a year
Financial support for the birth of your child or unhappy events.
Learning and development opportunities - allocated budget for certifications and/or trainings.
